title: Reconstruction or Semantics? What Makes a Latent Space Useful for Robotic World Models
summary: World model-based policy evaluation is a practical proxy for testing real-world robot control by rolling out candidate actions in action-conditioned video diffusion models. As these models increasingly adopt latent diffusion modeling (LDM), choosing the right latent space becomes critical. While the status quo uses autoencoding latent spaces like VAEs that are primarily trained for pixel reconstruction, recent work suggests benefits from pretrained encoders with representation-aligned semantic latent spaces. We systematically evaluate these latent spaces for action-conditioned LDM by comparing six reconstruction and semantic encoders to train world model variants under a fixed protocol on BridgeV2 dataset, and show effective world model training in high-dimensional representation spaces with and without dimension compression. We then propose three axes to assess robotic world model performance: visual fidelity, planning and downstream policy performance, and latent representation quality. Our results show visual fidelity alone is insufficient for world model selection. While reconstruction encoders like VAE and Cosmos achieve strong pixel-level scores, semantic encoders such as V-JEPA 2.1 (strongest overall on policy), Web-DINO, and SigLIP 2 generally excel across the other two axes at all model scales. Our study advocates semantic latent space as stronger foundation for policy-relevant robotics diffusion world models.
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates whether reconstruction-focused or semantic latent spaces are more effective for training action-conditioned world models in robotics, finding that semantic encoders generally outperform on policy-relevant metrics despite weaker pixel-level reconstruction.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了在机器人世界模型中，基于重建的潜空间与基于语义的潜空间哪个更有效。研究发现，在固定协议下，尽管重建编码器在像素级得分上表现更强，但语义编码器在规划和下游策略性能等更相关的指标上普遍表现更优，尤其适合策略相关的机器人扩散世界模型。
summary_zh: 基于世界模型的策略评估通过将候选动作在动作条件视频扩散模型中推演，为测试真实世界机器人控制提供了一种实用代理。随着这些模型日益采用潜在扩散模型，选择合适的潜在空间变得至关重要。虽然现状主要使用为像素重建而训练的自动编码潜在空间（如VAE），但最新研究表明，具有表征对齐语义潜在空间的预训练编码器能带来优势。我们通过在BridgeV2数据集上采用固定协议，比较六种重建与语义编码器来训练世界模型变体，系统评估了这些潜在空间在动作条件潜在扩散模型中的应用，并展示了在高维表征空间（无论是否进行维度压缩）中实现有效世界模型训练的可行性。进而提出评估机器人世界模型性能的三个维度：视觉保真度、规划与下游策略性能以及潜在表征质量。实验结果表明，仅凭视觉保真度不足以作为世界模型选择的依据。尽管VAE和Cosmos等重建编码器在像素级指标上表现优异，但V-JEPA 2.1（策略性能总体最优）、Web-DINO和SigLIP 2等语义编码器在所有模型规模上普遍在另外两个维度表现更优。本研究论证了语义潜在空间能为策略相关的机器人扩散世界模型提供更坚实的基础。

title: Structure-Preserving Gaussian Processes Via Discrete Euler-Lagrange Equations
summary: In this paper, we propose Lagrangian Gaussian Processes (LGPs) for probabilistic and data-efficient learning of dynamics via discrete forced Euler-Lagrange equations. Importantly, the geometric structure of the Lagrange-d'Alembert principle, which governs the motion of dynamical systems, is preserved by construction in the absence of external forces. This allows learning physically consistent models that overcome erroneous drift in the system's energy, thereby providing stable long-term predictions. At the core of our approach lie linear operators for Gaussian process conditioning, constructed from discrete forced Euler-Lagrange equations and variational discretization schemes. Thereby and unlike prior work, the method enables learning dynamics from discrete position snapshots, i.e., without access to a system's velocities or momenta. This is particularly relevant for a large class of practical scenarios where only position measurements are available, for instance, in motion capture or visual servoing applications. We demonstrate the data-efficiency and generalization capabilities of the LGPs in various synthetic and real-world case studies, including a real-world soft robot with hysteresis. The experimental results underscore that the LGPs learn physically consistent dynamics with uncertainty quantification solely from sparse positional data and enable stable long-term predictions.
tldr: This paper introduces Lagrangian Gaussian Processes (LGPs), a method for learning dynamical systems from only position data using discrete Euler-Lagrange equations. It preserves geometric structure to ensure physical consistency, enabling stable long-term predictions and uncertainty quantification, which is demonstrated on synthetic and real-world systems, including a soft robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出拉格朗日高斯过程（LGPs），一种利用离散欧拉-拉格朗日方程仅从位置数据学习动力学系统的方法。该方法保持了动力学系统的几何结构以确保物理一致性，从而能进行稳定的长期预测和不确定性量化，并在包括软体机器人在内的合成及真实系统上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 本文提出拉格朗日高斯过程（LGPs），通过离散受迫欧拉-拉格朗日方程实现动力学系统的概率性数据高效学习。关键在于，该方法在构造上保持了支配动力学系统运动的拉格朗日-达朗贝尔原理的几何结构（无外力作用时），从而能够学习到物理一致的模型，克服系统能量漂移误差，实现稳定的长期预测。该方法的核心在于构建基于离散受迫欧拉-拉格朗日方程和变分离散化方案的高斯过程条件化线性算子。与现有研究不同，该方法支持仅通过离散位置快照学习动力学系统，即无需获取系统速度或动量信息。这对于仅能获得位置测量值的广泛实际应用场景（如运动捕捉或视觉伺服）具有特殊意义。我们通过多组合成与真实案例研究（包括具有迟滞效应的真实软体机器人）验证了LGPs的数据效率与泛化能力。实验结果表明，LGPs仅通过稀疏位置数据即可学习具有不确定度量化功能的物理一致动力学模型，并能实现稳定的长期预测。
